tier2_explanatory.short_meaning: God is my oath; devoted to God
tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Elisheva, 'God is my oath', via the Spanish Isabel. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-sh-b-ʿ. Elizabeth, mother of John the Baptist (Luke 1). Isabella is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my oath; devoted to God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
